landing_findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
landing_findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

landing_findings.message: Little motion: 13 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
landing_findings.fix: Give every section an entrance for its parts (not one fade of the whole block) and add one moving picture: a looping clip or a slow move on a photograph.

app_findings.message: 40% of the first screen is one empty block (1440×360px at 0,540).
app_findings.fix: Place the void on purpose or fill it: move the picture, the film or one fact into it, grow the headline to meet it, or shrink the screen to its content. A void reads as placed only when something closes it on the far side and it is the screen's one rest.

warnings_explained.no-footage: User has not authorized video upload; the real interface and recorded observations are the appropriate visual material.
warnings_explained.still-page: 13 measured entrances plus working evidence tabs and control feedback; deliberate restraint instead of continuous distracting motion.
warnings_explained.hero-void: Simulator contains the one real station configuration; the empty tail of a tall desktop viewport avoids invented filler.

manual_review: Landing, Overview, Investigations, Simulator and recorded evidence screenshots inspected; desktop/tablet/mobile reviewed. Tablet links kept intact, sample-tab labels wrap on phone, and reduced-motion content stays visible.
known_limit: Automated accessibility is not comprehensive certification; SVG contrast requires manual review.
